name: Blood in the Streets
summary: Turmoil grips Dalaran after its barrier comes down. Once the patrols are dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare sees a chance for the Horde to enter and learn the mages' secrets. You carry a key from the internment camp to the sewers on the city's northern edge.

sections.title: A Disagreeable Way In
sections.body: With the patrols dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare says turmoil grips Dalaran since its barrier came down. He urges the Horde to enter and learn the mages' secrets while they can. You carry the key from the internment camp to the sewers on Dalaran's northern edge, by Lordamere Lake. Perhaps the mages left that disagreeable entrance unwarded.

sections.title: What Comes of the Key
sections.body: The Image of Archmage Modera tells you to lower your weapon. She says the key cannot get you past her wards; the mages would not leave such a weakness open now. She says the Horde's interest in her city is no coincidence. She counted on it and has a proposition for you.

faq.q: Who sends you into Dalaran's sewers?
aliases: blood in the streets quest giver
who gives blood in the streets
faq.answer: Once the patrols are dealt with, Magus Wordeen Voidglare sends you into Dalaran's sewers.

faq.q: Where is the entrance into Dalaran located?
faq.answer: The sewers lie on Dalaran's northern edge, by Lordamere Lake.

faq.q: What key is used to attempt entry?
aliases: where did the key come from
faq.answer: You carry the grimy key from the internment camp.

faq.q: Why is Dalaran vulnerable right now?
faq.answer: Dalaran's barrier has come down, and turmoil grips the city.
